base.formula: Bloomberg consensus EPS (FY1, BEST_EPS) x adjusted trailing-median P/E (PX_LAST / IS_COMP_EPS_ADJUSTED)

basis.definition: Bloomberg consensus (BEST) estimate of earnings per share for the overridden fiscal period.

trailing_median_pe.window_rule: every closed fiscal year before FY1 carrying both a PX_LAST and a positive IS_COMP_EPS_ADJUSTED figure, joined on fiscal_year

basis.definition: Fiscal-year closing price (PX_LAST, the security's trading currency, brought to the EPS unit) divided by Bloomberg's adjusted (comparable) earnings per share (IS_COMP_EPS_ADJUSTED), joined on fiscal_year; the median over the closed fiscal years carrying both with adjusted EPS above zero.
